capabilities: Highlight exact text selections inside fenced code blocks using local anchors
Add or remove whole-line highlights via hl: fence metadata
Render highlights in the editor and Reading view with a built-in renderer
Access highlight commands from the editor context menu
Migrate legacy ht: metadata into plugin storage
disambiguation: Despite the name, it can also highlight exact text selections stored in plugin-local data, not only whole lines.
extras: The community listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Exact-text highlights are stored in the plugin's data.json rather than in notes, so uninstalling the plugin or syncing only Markdown files loses them; the README urges backing up plugin data. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later.
problem: Markdown has no built-in way to emphasize specific lines or text in a fenced code block without rewriting the code content or adding custom CSS.

relations.evidence: Provide its own full-line background layer without Codeblock Customizer, Code Styler, themes, or external CSS snippets.
Provide its own full-line background layer without Codeblock Customizer, Code Styler, themes, or external CSS snippets.

summary: Highlights selected lines or exact text inside fenced code blocks in editor and Reading view without modifying the code itself.
